summary: All four occurrences retain chewing; preparation of food for another person changes the beneficiary, not the lexical sense. No distinct feeding sense is created.
The Detransitive Infectum has food as patient and b-marked teeth as instrument; there is no expressed chewing agent. Its missing lexical heading is supplied without duplicating the existing example.

The Infectum-wa with xwazzi is a wish, not an assertion of customary past chewing. -li indexes the beneficiary; the following -yo should be checked as indexing the chewed theme. The source vowel ləʕsat- is not silently substituted into the inherited loʕsat- text.
The correspondence about citation Preterit forms is retained verbatim as an existing note; no running-text Preterit attestation occurs in this sample.
